core_mechanic: Read an equation with one blank/wrong term embedded in a broken object and supply the value that makes it true to 'fix' the object.

keep.name: Gadget Repair Shop
keep.why_best: Cleanest direct instantiation of find-the-missing-addend (1.OA.D.8); strong restore-payoff, fully DOM-feasible, most original repair frame.

core_mechanic: Diagnose the wrong or missing letter in a shown word and replace/restore it from a tray to make the correct spelling.

keep.name: Word Doctor's Clinic
keep.why_best: Clear orthographic error-detection with TTS confirm; the clinic frame is warm and the diagnose-then-replace loop is the cleanest of the spelling-repair set.

core_mechanic: Find the grammatically wrong word in a complete sentence and swap it for the correct form (agreement/tense/conventions).

keep.name: Sentence Surgeon
keep.why_best: Whole-sentence syntactic diagnosis (agreement/tense) with TTS read-back; broader conventions coverage than the punctuation-only sibling.

core_mechanic: Read a target time and drag the analog clock hands (radial atan2-snap) to that position.

keep.name: Set the Clock Hands
keep.why_best: Direct radial-drag telling-time on the proven E10 clock-core; both half-hour and 5-minute ladders; identical-mechanic siblings (Clockwork Fixer) absorbed.

core_mechanic: Build a target number by supplying ten-blocks and ones-tiles into a structured frame to show its tens-and-ones composition.

keep.name: Ten-Frame Tile Restorer
keep.why_best: Base-ten composition as restoration; tens+ones into a mosaic gives a tactile place-value build distinct from the column-machine variant.

core_mechanic: Drag missing numbered ties/tokens into the gaps of a number line so the sequence/skip-count reads correctly in order.

keep.name: Number-Line Track Repair
keep.why_best: Reconstruct-the-missing-structure on a number line (sequence/skip-count) with a satisfying train payoff; cleaner than the open-slot sort sibling.

core_mechanic: Read a sentence/caption with a missing word and choose the one word that correctly completes its meaning.

keep.name: Torn Picture Mender
keep.why_best: Meaning/context cloze (comprehension+vocabulary) with a warm seam-mend payoff and TTS read-back; distinct from phonics letter-restore.

core_mechanic: Read/hear a narrated quantity story (join/separate/compare) and dial or tap the result number.

keep.name: Vet's Diagnosis Window
keep.why_best: Cleanest add-to/take-from word-problem-to-result (1.OA.A.1) with a heal-the-patient payoff and a number dial; absorbs the dialogue-framed sibling.

core_mechanic: Infer the repeating/growing rule from a partial pattern and supply the missing element(s) to continue it.

keep.name: Pattern Rail Builder
keep.why_best: Pattern-extension by snapping the next rail-tiles; train-rolls payoff; strongest of the many pattern-continue variants and clean DOM ordered-slot check.

cluster_name: Comparison / Balance to Equality (the equal sign)
core_mechanic: Read two expressions/quantities and add or place a value so both sides are equal, with a tilting scale/balance as feedback.

keep.name: See-Saw Stack
keep.why_best: Comparison-by-construction with real-time beam tilt covers =, >, < and the meaning of the equal sign; the richest balance variant, all DOM.

core_mechanic: Evaluate a comparison/equality constraint and place the one patch/valve that balances a broken flow system.

keep.name: Pipe Leak Patch
keep.why_best: Comparison/equality as a diagnostic with water-physics payoff; distinct enough from the symbolic balance scale by being choose-the-one-patch with system feedback.

core_mechanic: Give up items whose total value equals an unlike target item, sealing a trade only when both sides balance.

keep.name: The Fair-Trade Post
keep.why_best: Pure value-equivalence across unlike units (1.OA.D.7); the barter frame is original and the balance-seal is satisfying and DOM-trivial.

core_mechanic: Exchange ten of a smaller unit for one of the next place (or break one larger into ten smaller), composing/decomposing base-ten units.

keep.name: Tens-Frame Carry Machine
keep.why_best: Threshold auto-bundle (ten ones -> one ten) is the cleanest, most delightful regroup transform; absorbs the bank/cashier/packing-line variants.

cluster_name: Make Exact Money (coins to a price)
core_mechanic: Drag/tap mixed coins to compose exactly a target price from non-uniform denominations.

keep.name: Exact-Change Market Stall
keep.why_best: Money composition to an exact total with running readout and return-on-overshoot; the canonical 2.MD.C.8 instantiation, absorbing the register/stack/ramp variants.

absorbed.name: Roll the Coin Down the Ramp

core_mechanic: Tap/add whole-number-valued items so the running tray total hits a target exactly (multiple decompositions allowed).

keep.name: Make-the-Total Vending Wall
keep.why_best: Find-addend-combinations-to-target with many valid answers (1.OA.D.8/K.OA.A.4); freedom of choice is the fun, clean running-sum gate.

core_mechanic: Swap a fraction tile for a different-looking but numerically-equal one, gated by equal shaded area.

keep.name: Equivalent-Fraction Swap Meet
keep.why_best: Proportional equal-area equivalence (1/2 = 2/4); the only equivalent-fraction swap design and a clean SVG proportional check.

core_mechanic: Route earned word cards into the page/bin whose rime or word-family they share.

keep.name: Word-Family Sticker Vault
keep.why_best: Rime-gated acquisition into a curated album; the cleanest word-family sort with a satisfying complete-the-page payoff.

cluster_name: Accept/Reject by a Category Rule (curate a set)
core_mechanic: Accept only the items that meet a stated category rule and wave away the rest to build a rule-matching collection.

keep.name: Museum Wing Curator
keep.why_best: Binary keep/decline against a stated rule (classify-and-count readiness, geometry/phonics); the curator frame is original and the rule is explicit.

core_mechanic: Assemble a complete ordered/numbered set by placing revealed cards into their correct numbered frames (1..N).

keep.name: Set-Completer Card Packs
keep.why_best: Sequence/cardinality via assembling an ordered set with pack-open thrill; distinct from a number line by being frame-by-number completion.

core_mechanic: Trade in a word that means the same as the trader's wanted word (semantic-equivalence gate).

keep.name: Synonym Swap Bazaar
keep.why_best: Meaning-equivalence (synonyms) as a fair trade; clean curated-list gate and the canonical synonym design.

core_mechanic: Trade in a word that is the opposite of the trader's wanted word (antonym gate).

keep.name: Antonym Trading Post
keep.why_best: Opposite-meaning relation is a genuinely different cognitive task and CCSS skill from synonyms; clean antonym-pair gate.

core_mechanic: Match an analog clock face to a different representation (digital / word) of the same time.

keep.name: Same-Time Clock Trader
keep.why_best: Teaches time-telling equivalence across representations; distinct from setting hands (it is reading-and-matching), clean equality check.

core_mechanic: Count a scene to earn that many tokens, then spend exactly those tokens to buy an item (cardinality -> exact spend).

keep.name: Tally-Token Earn & Spend
keep.why_best: Two linked acts (count to earn, pay exactly to spend) make cardinality concrete; the only earn-then-spend-by-count loop.

core_mechanic: Feed the word-coin that rhymes with a machine's label to collect its prize (auditory rhyme gate).

keep.name: Rhyme-Coin Gumball Shop
keep.why_best: Rhyme (sound relationship) as currency with a gumball-drop payoff; distinct from rime-spelling sort by being auditory and spend-to-collect.

core_mechanic: Measure objects against a unit ruler and trade across only the one whose measured length equals the wanted measure.

keep.name: Measure-and-Match Length Trader
keep.why_best: Length-equality via counting units; distinct measurement-domain equivalence trade, clean unit-count gate.

core_mechanic: Lay numbered length-segments end-to-end to span exactly a measured gap (1D linear length/addend composition).

keep.name: Bridge the Gap
keep.why_best: 1D made-to-measure span encoding addend/length with a clean fit-check; distinct from area tiling and from number-line repair.

core_mechanic: Listen to a word and stack one floor/block per syllable so tower height equals the syllable count.

keep.name: Syllable Skyscraper
keep.why_best: Syllable count = building height; recognition-first, no spelling; the cleanest syllable-as-height build with replay-per-floor.

core_mechanic: Combine an onset segment and a rime segment into one real word that names the picture (sub-word blending).

keep.name: Word Wall Bricks
keep.why_best: Two different segment-types assemble into a new word with TTS blend; the clean RF.K.2.c blending-by-construction design.

absorbed.name: Sound Sequence: Make the Word in Order

core_mechanic: Lay unit-square tiles to fill a blueprint exactly, forming a 2D array whose rows and columns can be counted.

keep.name: Blueprint Tiles
keep.why_best: Builds array/area structure (rows x columns) by tiling; the foundation-of-multiplication design with a clean grid fill-check.

core_mechanic: Fit equal wedge-pieces into a tin to assemble a pie that exactly matches a target fraction.

keep.name: Fraction Pie Bakery
keep.why_best: Construction-to-a-fraction by assembling equal wedges; the cleanest unit-fractions-by-building design, radial equal-partition.

core_mechanic: Assemble word-cards left-to-right into a frame so the structure reads as a complete, correctly-ordered, capitalized, end-punctuated sentence.

keep.name: Sentence Scaffold
keep.why_best: Sentence-level word-order assembly enforcing capital-first/end-mark-last with TTS read; the cleanest productive-sentence build.

core_mechanic: Order a whole set by value via fit-nesting or full sort so smaller-inside-larger / least-to-greatest holds across the set.

keep.name: Nesting Number Boxes
keep.why_best: Full seriation by containment where a wrong-value box literally won't fit; tactile ordering distinct from two-way comparison.

absorbed.name: Shelve the Library Books by Number

core_mechanic: Build two part-pillars whose heights together support one whole (part + part = whole decomposition).

keep.name: Number Bond Bridge
keep.why_best: Part-part-whole via twin load-bearing supports; clean level-rest check and the canonical decompose-into-two-addends build.

core_mechanic: Fit intermediate gears so the chain meshes and a counter ticks the skip-count as the train turns.

keep.name: Gear Train Builder
keep.why_best: 2D connectivity-and-mesh build encoding skip-counting/equal-groups; distinct from linear pattern by being a connectivity construction.

core_mechanic: Build two towers to given numerals and place the >,<,= symbol-brick so its mouth faces the larger, forming a written comparison.

keep.name: Comparison Wall
keep.why_best: Produces a written comparison statement (12 > 8) rather than a felt relation; the only design that assembles the relational symbol explicitly.

core_mechanic: Fuse two full word-blocks into one compound word, welding only when they make a real compound.

keep.name: Compound Word Crane
keep.why_best: Morphological build at the word level (sun+flower); distinct from sub-word blending; clean compound-list lookup with TTS.

core_mechanic: Place tiles/parts on the empty side of a mirror-line so the finished structure is symmetric (compute the reflected position).

keep.name: Symmetry Builder
keep.why_best: Every part has one reflection-correct spot enforcing line-symmetry; the cleanest place-the-mirror-half design (absorbs the tap-cell and quadrant variants).

core_mechanic: Draw straight cut lines (snapped to valid axes) to partition a shape into the requested number of equal parts.

keep.name: Slice the Snack
keep.why_best: Active-partition fractions facet (deferred in live E14) via a drawn snap-evaluated cut; the cleanest generate-the-partition design.

core_mechanic: Draw the line of symmetry onto a complete figure; the figure folds along the drawn stroke to self-test.

keep.name: Draw the Mirror Line
keep.why_best: Locate-and-draw the axis (not given), figure self-tests by folding; distinct from placing/folding a half. Snap to pre-known axes keeps it feasible.

core_mechanic: Draw cut-marks snapped to ruler ticks to divide a ribbon/tape into the requested number of equal unit pieces.

keep.name: Cut the Ribbon into Units
keep.why_best: Linear length partition (unit iteration / measurement) distinct from area fractions; clean tick-snap split.

core_mechanic: Draw a continuous trail joining dots in numeric or alphabetic order; out-of-order dots reject; the reveal is the payoff.

keep.name: Connect the Dots: Count to Reveal
keep.why_best: Ordered-trail-reveal for counting sequence; the cleanest numeric dot-to-dot. The alphabet variant absorbs as an ELA re-curriculum.

core_mechanic: Swipe-paint exactly the requested number of regions of a pre-partitioned shape to show a fraction (numerator over set denominator).

keep.name: Shade the Fraction
keep.why_best: Numerator-over-denominator via region-fill; distinct from creating the partition. Region-snapped painting is trivial DOM.

cluster_name: Ring/Partition a Set into Equal Groups
core_mechanic: Draw loops around objects to partition a discrete set into equal groups (early multiplication/division readiness).

keep.name: Ring the Groups
keep.why_best: Free-drawn enclosure partitions a discrete set into equal groups; the cleanest equal-grouping-by-drawing design (grid-snap mitigates the loop-capture cost).

absorbed.name: Build the Same Tower for Each

core_mechanic: Draw the missing symmetric half stroke-by-stroke using a faint mirror grid-guide until the picture is whole.

keep.name: Draw the Missing Half
keep.why_best: Generative copy-by-symmetry (produce the mirror half) distinct from placing tiles or drawing only the axis; lenient grid-cell ink-coverage keeps it K-3-true.

core_mechanic: Count a quantity, decide which numeral it is, then trace that numeral along a lenient directional stroke-guide.

keep.name: Trace to Write the Numeral
keep.why_best: Couples cardinality with generative numeral formation (the child decides WHICH numeral then writes it); lenient checkpoint trace, no exact handwriting.

core_mechanic: Draw whole-number hop-arcs above a number line from start to target so the jumps sum exactly to the target.

keep.name: Bridge the Number Line
keep.why_best: Drawn jump-arcs externalize add/subtract strategy on a number line; the arcs ARE the equation, distinct from tap/slide markers.

core_mechanic: Hear a letter sound, decide the letter, and form it by tracing a lenient stroke-order guide (sound->symbol->formation).

keep.name: Trace the Letter, Hear the Sound
keep.why_best: Generative letter formation gated by phonics (infer the letter from audio); uses pre-recorded phoneme clips per the project's TTS finding.

core_mechanic: Draw one cut along the join of a composite figure to separate it into its two named component shapes.

keep.name: Cut Apart the Two Shapes
keep.why_best: Decompose-a-composite (compose/decompose geometry) by cutting the seam; distinct from equal-partition cuts. Single valid seam keeps it a simple line-match.

core_mechanic: Paint regions whose color is gated by reading a number-word or solving a small sum, revealing a picture.

keep.name: Color by Number-Word
keep.why_best: Coloring gated by number-word literacy + addition; classic color-by-number calm, region-snapped, distinct from shading a fraction quantity.

core_mechanic: Align a measuring tool (ruler) to an object's start and read the number on the scale where it ends.

keep.name: Ruler Lab
keep.why_best: Position-a-tool + read-a-continuous-scale is the canonical 2.MD.A.1; clean draggable-ruler + tap-to-read, reusable component.

core_mechanic: Lay identical unit objects end-to-end with no gaps/overlaps along an object, then count the units to report length.

keep.name: Unit-Train Lay-Down
keep.why_best: Constructs the unit count by iterating identical objects (no pre-marked scale); the canonical 1.MD.A.2 iterate-units design, distinct from reading a ruler.

core_mechanic: Commit a reasoned estimate (count/length/distance) on a slider, then reveal/measure the actual and compare.

keep.name: Estimate-Then-Reveal Jar
keep.why_best: The predict-then-check loop with a committed estimate then verified count; the cleanest estimation design, absorbs the length/distance variants.

core_mechanic: Load objects on two pans and read the tilt to discover which is heavier/lighter (compare measurable attribute).

keep.name: Balance Discoverer
keep.why_best: Apparatus produces the verdict (heavier/lighter) by tipping; the canonical K.MD.A.2 weight-compare, distinct from balancing to equality.

core_mechanic: Control a continuous pour to stop the liquid at a marked target fill-line on a graduated vessel.

keep.name: Pour-to-the-Line
keep.why_best: Tune-a-continuous-quantity-to-a-reading (capacity); clean hold-to-fill against a target marker, distinct from a comparison pour.

core_mechanic: Pour one container's contents into a differently-shaped one to discover which holds more (overflow / room left).

keep.name: Which Holds More?
keep.why_best: Conservation-of-volume comparison discovered by transfer, overturning the look-bigger trap; distinct from pour-to-a-line.

core_mechanic: Rotate a dial to calibrate a numeric readout to a target value (continuous control to a number).

keep.name: Tune-the-Dial Number
keep.why_best: Calibrate a continuous control to a target number (numeral recognition/count); odometer flip is satisfying, distinct from a transform machine.

core_mechanic: Mix two inputs and observe the emergent result, testing combinations to find which produces the target, with a tried-record strip.

keep.name: Combo Mixer Test
keep.why_best: Hypothesis-testing sandbox with a data record (which combination produces an effect); distinct from a fixed transform. Absorbs the predict-the-color sibling.

core_mechanic: Run repeated trials (spins), record each into a tally/bar chart, then read which outcome occurs most.

keep.name: Tally Tester Spinner
keep.why_best: Trial -> record -> interpret produces a real dataset (represent & interpret data, 2.MD.D.10); the only data-generation design.

core_mechanic: Use a diagram's labels/captions to identify the part that performs a stated function (use text features to find an answer).

keep.name: Read-the-Diagram Detective (ELA)
keep.why_best: Use-text-features comprehension (1.RI.5/2.RI.5) driven by reading labels, not visual search; the only diagram-reading design.

core_mechanic: Read a vertical thermometer scale and tap/drag to the matching temperature value (or set-to-target zone).

keep.name: Thermometer Reader
keep.why_best: Vertical scale tied to a sensed thermal state with a set-to-target sub-mode (2.MD.B.6); distinct affordance from the horizontal ruler.

core_mechanic: Sweep a flashlight beam over a dark scene; objects whose name begins with the target sound 'wake up' and glow to be collected.

keep.name: Flashlight Phonics Cave
keep.why_best: Continuous sweep-to-expose with the phonics match gating the reveal-glow; original beam-as-tool mechanic, clean pointer + opacity DOM.

core_mechanic: Slide an x-ray window over an object to reveal a hidden dot-cluster and tap the numeral matching how many you see.

keep.name: X-Ray Number Bones
keep.why_best: Temporary x-ray window forces real subitizing/counting (K.CC.B.5); clean clip/mask reveal, distinct from sweep or develop.

core_mechanic: Gather evidence along a clue trail and deduce which suspect matches all accumulated attributes.

keep.name: Footprint Detective
keep.why_best: Inferential clue-gathering deduction (RL key details) where no single clue solves it; the forensic-trail framing is original.

core_mechanic: Each correct letter-sound/sight-word tap dissipates fog, progressively revealing a hidden word to read aloud.

keep.name: Fog-Lift Word Mountain
keep.why_best: Continuous reveal of a word into legibility tied to letter-sound/sight-word matching; the reading payoff distinguishes it from picture-reveal grids.

core_mechanic: Drag a magnifier to make tiny hidden letters readable, then tap the bug-letters in order to spell the target word.

keep.name: Magnifier Spelling Bug Hunt
keep.why_best: Lens changes legibility (true reveal tool) and the task is ordered spelling (RF.K.3.b); distinct search-and-magnify discovery.

core_mechanic: Ping to briefly reveal hidden creatures with an audio name/sound cue; tap where the named-sound target is hiding.

keep.name: Sound Sonar (Hidden in the Deep)
keep.why_best: Primary detection channel is audio/echo pairing a heard sound to a glimpsed location; the only sense-by-listening reveal, distinct from visual sweeps.

core_mechanic: Given the whole and the visible part, lift flaps to discover the hidden quantity and identify the missing addend.

keep.name: Lift-the-Flap Math Story
keep.why_best: Part-part-whole decomposition where the reveal IS the unknown part (K.OA.A.3); classic lift-the-flap joy, distinct from picture reveal.

core_mechanic: Pick the correct colored filter/lens that makes a hidden picture or word pop out of camouflage, then identify it.

keep.name: Color-Filter Lens Reveal
keep.why_best: Tool-selection-to-expose (which decoder unlocks the image) is a distinct discovery mechanic with secret-decoder delight; CSS blend/mask feasible.

core_mechanic: Brush/scratch away a covering to expose a hidden letter or image, then case-match or infer from the (partial) reveal.

keep.name: Dust-for-Prints Letter Match
keep.why_best: Uncover-then-match with a forensic dusting gesture targeting upper/lowercase matching (RF.K.1.d); canvas-brushing is a known simple recipe.

core_mechanic: Turn a decoder wheel to map each cipher symbol to its hidden letter, then spell out the decoded word.

keep.name: Decoder Wheel Secret Message
keep.why_best: Rotary symbol->letter correspondence + spell (RF.K.3.b); the cipher-cracking flow is its own core, distinct from picking a filter.

core_mechanic: Descriptive clues arrive one at a time; the child eliminates candidates and guesses the described word/concept when ready.

keep.name: Riddle Reveal (Deduce the Mystery Word)
keep.why_best: Progressive clue-narrowing word deduction (vocabulary/category reasoning) with guess-when-ready; the cleanest riddle design, absorbs door/peephole variants.

core_mechanic: Solve an ordered clue at each step (letter/number sequence) to uncover the next leg of a hidden route to the treasure.

keep.name: Treasure Map Clue Trail (Sequence)
keep.why_best: Discover/construct a hidden path by solving an ordered sequence clue per step (count-on/order); distinct from traversing a known path.

core_mechanic: Cross-reference multiple positive/negative clues to assign each item to its unique owner by process-of-elimination.

keep.name: Detective's Clue Board
keep.why_best: True logic-grid constraint-satisfaction (no single clue solves it); clues glow as satisfied; the canonical multi-clue deduction engine.

core_mechanic: Place pictures so no row/column (and box) repeats, deducing the forced value for each cell from grid constraints.

keep.name: Sudoku Picture Path (Mini Constraint Grid)
keep.why_best: Cross-region constraint deduction with the 2x2-box adding genuine intersection reasoning; the richer of the two grid-constraint designs.

core_mechanic: Infer a hidden classification rule from worked examples, then sort new items correctly to confirm it.

keep.name: Guess My Rule (Sorting Machine)
keep.why_best: Rule-INDUCTION from examples (the inverse of stated-category sort); the child generates the hypothesis. The only rule-discovery design.

core_mechanic: Judge a math/fact claim true or false and, on false, tap the evidence that proves why.

keep.name: True, False, or Why (Math Statement Court)
keep.why_best: Two-stage truth-evaluation + justification (locate the evidence) instantiates equality/comparison reasoning; the proof-tap is the distinct move.

core_mechanic: Tap the item that breaks the shared property, then tap the attribute-card that says WHY it is odd.

keep.name: Which One Breaks the Rule (Odd-One-Out With a Reason)
keep.why_best: Adds explicit attribute-articulation (the reason-card) over plain odd-one-out; instantiates attribute-classification, the distinct WHY layer.

core_mechanic: Infer an unobserved ordering by chaining two weighings (A>B, B>C, so A>C) and act on the deduced order.

keep.name: Balance Scale Detective
keep.why_best: Transitive/comparative deduction from physics-state clues; chaining two weighings is a meaningfully distinct reasoning shape from direct compare.

core_mechanic: Extract the relation from the first picture-pair and transfer it to complete the second pair.

keep.name: Finish the Analogy (Pair Logic)
keep.why_best: Analogical reasoning (1:1 relation transfer across two pairs); distinct from feature matching and from sequence iteration. The only analogy design.

core_mechanic: Infer a hidden transformation rule along a sequence (grow/+2/rotate) and tap the next or missing term.

keep.name: Crack the Pattern Code
keep.why_best: Sequence rule-induction with a transformation (not just repeat); distinct from analogy and from repeat-pattern continue. The probe-the-interior variant is the distinguisher.

core_mechanic: Cross-reference story-derived clues against suspects and accuse the one who fits all clues (narrative inference).

keep.name: Whodunit Story Clues
keep.why_best: Narrative inference + elimination from text/illustration evidence (RL inference); distinct from abstract logic-grid by requiring reading comprehension.

core_mechanic: Reason backward from a desired truth-state and change a numeral/symbol/counter to make a false equation true.

keep.name: Make the Statement True (Fix the Equation)
keep.why_best: Repair-to-truth (the inverse of computing a sum) instantiating the equal sign + comparison; distinct from judging true/false. The choose-symbol variant is included.

core_mechanic: Pair objects with buddy-lines and reason from whether one is left over to call even or odd.

keep.name: Even/Odd Pair-Up Reasoning
keep.why_best: Deductive parity via the pairing argument (2.OA.C.3), constructing the proof from a leftover; the only pair-to-deduce-parity design.

core_mechanic: Reproduce exactly the quantity shown in a model by placing the same number of items (one-to-one equality).

keep.name: Build It Like Mine
keep.why_best: A model defines a precise count the child must reproduce; equality-of-count is the win. Clean compare-placed-vs-model, distinct from free build.

core_mechanic: Reproduce a model's exact ordered sequence (bead/chunk order) tile-by-tile.

keep.name: Copy the Bead String
keep.why_best: Reproduction of an ordered pattern (AB/ABC structure) by exact-order match; distinct from free composition. The chunk-order ELA variant absorbs.

core_mechanic: Copy a shown word letter-for-letter from a scrambled tray into your own strip (visible-model spelling).

keep.name: Echo the Word
keep.why_best: Pure letter-sequence replication of a visible model (handwriting-copy analog) with TTS; distinct from decoding from picture/sound.

core_mechanic: Reproduce a model body-pose under left-right reflection (true mirror) on a facing figure.

keep.name: Mirror Move Dance
keep.why_best: Discrete pose-copy under reflection teaches the mirror L-R swap explicitly via dance partners; distinct from axis-reflection on a figure.

core_mechanic: Set each of your own bars/towers to the same height as the matching model bar (reproduce a multi-bar profile).

keep.name: Copy the Skyline (Bar Match)
keep.why_best: Faithful reproduction of relative heights (measurement & comparison via copying); distinct from data-count chart and from quantity-twin.

core_mechanic: Place pattern-block shapes in the right positions/orientations to reproduce a shown composite figure.

keep.name: Replicate the Pattern Block Picture
keep.why_best: 2D shape-composition that reproduces a given figure (compose/decompose shapes); distinct from free composition and from grid-pack/tangram.

core_mechanic: Reproduce a shown array's exact shape (same rows, same per-row count) on an empty grid.

keep.name: Copy the Caterpillar (Array Twin)
keep.why_best: Replicate-the-2D-structure (rows x columns) of a shown array; distinct from build-to-a-number (E13) and from compose-shapes-to-replicate by copying an array's exact shape.

core_mechanic: Interpret a customer's natural-language request (count/attribute/phoneme) and assemble the matching order.

keep.name: Serve the Customer
keep.why_best: Apply-a-spoken-rule in a server role with a varying single constraint; conversational request framing, absorbs the single-quantity order-window.

core_mechanic: Assemble an imperative command (often a prepositional phrase) and watch a literal character enact it.

keep.name: Tell the Robot What to Do
keep.why_best: Child-authors-an-instruction (the reverse of comprehension games); preposition production with a comic enact. The single-step canonical.

core_mechanic: After a short story, an in-story character asks a comprehension question and the child taps the best answer.

keep.name: Answer the Story Character
keep.why_best: Comprehension recall framed as dialogue with the story's character; RL key details, distinct from authoring or retelling.

core_mechanic: Pick the polite/appropriate line for a puppet so the two-way conversation flows forward.

keep.name: Make the Puppet Speak
keep.why_best: Choose-your-line improv where social/grammar appropriateness drives the partner's reaction; distinct from recall Q&A. Absorbs the mediation variant.

core_mechanic: Choose the emotion that fits a line of dialogue and the puppet performs it in that mood (face + pacing).

keep.name: Whose Voice? (Read the Feeling)
keep.why_best: Interpret tone and direct delivery (HOW it is said, not what); the only prosody/expression design, strong for read-with-expression.

core_mechanic: Hold and reproduce a multi-part spoken order with conjunctions and quantities (listening span + connectives).

keep.name: Order at the Diner
keep.why_best: Parse a compound 'and'-joined multi-item request and reproduce the whole list; distinct from a single-constraint request by exercising connectives/span.

core_mechanic: Author an ordered sequence of direction words to guide a character along a route to a destination.

keep.name: Guide the Lost Traveler
keep.why_best: Produce a multi-step sequence of directions a character executes; sequencing + directional language, distinct from a single command.

core_mechanic: Reconstruct a heard story by sequencing beginning/middle/end statements and 'telling' it to a listener.

keep.name: Retell It to the Next Friend
keep.why_best: Full sequenced retell to an audience (retell familiar stories, describe events in order); distinct from a single recall question and from reorder-cards.

core_mechanic: Pick the action verb that matches what a depicted step needs, directing a character's task verb-by-verb.

keep.name: Coach the Robot Chef
keep.why_best: Choose-the-action-verb-in-context (verb meaning/category in a how-to) building a procedure; distinct from prepositions/directions.

core_mechanic: Assemble an open sequence of direction tiles into a program, then run it to navigate a character across a grid.

keep.name: Robot Recess
keep.why_best: Author an open 2D move-program (which turns, how many) and run it; spatial route-construction distinct from answering-to-advance. Absorbs the marble-run plan variant.

core_mechanic: Decode a positional/relational word (above/under/between/left-of) and place an object at the named spot.

keep.name: Park the Truck
keep.why_best: Resolve a relation among two+ landmarks (between / left-of-X-right-of-Y), the harder relational-position skill; absorbs single-relation and floor-plan variants.

core_mechanic: Read a column+row coordinate pair and tap/place at that exact grid cell.

keep.name: Treasure Coordinates
keep.why_best: Foundational ordered-pair (column x row) addressing; clean labeled-grid tap-to-reveal. The reveal-by-coordinate canonical; place-by-coordinate variant absorbs.

core_mechanic: At a fork, choose left/right to steer a traveler down the channel that satisfies a math decision (bigger/answer).

keep.name: River Steer
keep.why_best: Branching directional steering fused with a math decision per junction; distinct from a fixed-track advance. The canonical branch-steer.

core_mechanic: Sequence spatial stops in a stated order (first/next/last) over a map, then watch the route execute.

keep.name: Mail Route
keep.why_best: Ordinal route-planning over an open map (which stops, what order); distinct from track-advance and from abstract plan-strip, which absorbs here.

core_mechanic: Climb up/down a ladder by reading words at each rung, emphasizing the vertical top/bottom/above/below axis.

keep.name: Word Ladder Climb
keep.why_best: Emphasizes the vertical up/down positional axis with a climbing character; distinct from horizontal number line and 2D grids.

core_mechanic: Read each incoming item's number and set switches/route it to the matching numbered destination across a queue.

keep.name: Track-Switch Train Dispatcher
keep.why_best: Configure switches to route a stream by reading numbers (numeral recognition/ordering); the ongoing-operator routing system, clean toggle-state logic.

core_mechanic: Apply a posted arithmetic rule to each item in a stream and stamp the computed result.

keep.name: Stamp-Machine Rule Operator
keep.why_best: Apply a stated rule repeatedly (mental +10/-10) across a parcel stream; the canonical rule-machine, distinct from a single delightful transform.

core_mechanic: Compute a sum/difference and grant passage to the lane whose number equals the answer (running a crossing).

keep.name: Traffic-Signal Crossing Operator
keep.why_best: Compute a fact then route (2.OA.B.2) on a multi-road system; distinct from reading-a-given-number to route. The compute-then-route canonical.

core_mechanic: Add standard unit-weights to a pan until the scale matches a target weight reading (measurement to target).

keep.name: Parcel-Scale Weigh Station
keep.why_best: Read and match a measurement by adding standard units on a balance instrument (2.MD.A.1); distinct from value-compose and from compare-tilt.

core_mechanic: Read a word + picture clue and slide letter tiles into the empty slots to complete the CVC spelling.

keep.name: Marquee Letter-Tile Sign Operator
keep.why_best: Fill exact spelling slots (CVC phonics) from a tile rack with a picture clue; distinct from tracing and from free composition.

core_mechanic: Set hop-size and hop-count, then fire so equal arcs land exactly on a target (skip-count/multiplication).

keep.name: Hop Cannon
keep.why_best: Set a launch quantity (hop-size x count) encoding skip-count/multiply in one aimed shot; the equal-interval arc is distinct from question-by-question advance.

core_mechanic: Drag to stretch an elastic body to a target length against a ruler, reading the live length.

keep.name: Stretch the Caterpillar
keep.why_best: Meter a single elastic length against a ruler with a live readout; a distinct produce-a-measured-length act vs reading a static object.

core_mechanic: Pull-and-angle a slingshot/launcher so the projectile lands on the target that equals the given value (place-value / phonics match).

keep.name: Slingshot to the Tens
keep.why_best: A single aim-and-launch carries an equivalence match (expanded/place-value forms); the trajectory replaces a tap-pair. Absorbs the letter-launcher ELA variant.

core_mechanic: Place pegs to partition a 0-1 band into equal parts, then fill from 0 to a target point to show a fraction.

keep.name: Stretch-Band Fractions
keep.why_best: Partition-then-fill on an elastic whole (number-line fraction, 3.NF.A.2) distinct from a pre-marked pour and from open-length stretch.

core_mechanic: Pour/drop discrete items into a tube or ten-frame and stop when the accumulated level matches a target count.

keep.name: Fill the Ten-Frame Tank
keep.why_best: Meter a discrete pour against a base-ten ten-frame structure (number sense + count); the structured-fill is richer than a plain level tube, which absorbs.

core_mechanic: Wind a catapult to launch a numbered rock toward the nearer of two tens-pads (round to nearest ten).

keep.name: Catapult the Rounding Rock
keep.why_best: Focused two-pad rounding decision via a wind-and-fire launch; the only rounding design, distinct from multi-target equivalence aiming.

core_mechanic: Pour liquid into one pan against a fixed weight until the beam levels, reading the measured amount.

keep.name: Pour to Balance the Scale
keep.why_best: Continuous pour-to-balance (equality/measurement on a graduated cup); distinct from discrete stack-to-balance and from pour-to-a-line.

core_mechanic: Watch/hear an ordered pad sequence and reproduce it in the same order (auditory-visual sequence memory).

keep.name: Echo the Beat
keep.why_best: Call-and-response reproduce-an-ordered-sequence (count/order, growing length); the only Simon-style memory mechanic.

core_mechanic: Hear a sound and tap the picture that produced it (input modality is audio, answer is visual).

keep.name: Which Sound Was That?
keep.why_best: Pure listen-then-identify (auditory discrimination); the input-modality-reversed mechanic, replayable. Needs a curated SFX library.

core_mechanic: Hear a looping rhythm pattern and fill the blank slots with sound-shapes so the beat-pattern continues.

keep.name: Conduct the Pattern
keep.why_best: Continue a repeating pattern judged by ear/beat (auditory+temporal); distinct from the silent-visual pattern-continue (C009) by the auditory medium.

core_mechanic: Tap phoneme buttons in order then sweep them together (child-paced) until separate sounds fuse into a word.

keep.name: Blend it with Taps
keep.why_best: Auditory phoneme blending paced by a sweep (RF.K.2.d); distinct from spelling builders. Needs pre-recorded phoneme clips.

core_mechanic: Press-and-hold to stretch a spoken word so its phonemes pull apart; count the sound-dots that pop out.

keep.name: Stretch the Word
keep.why_best: Hold-to-stretch phoneme segmentation (the inverse of blending, RF.K.2.d); the tangible stretch gesture is the novel core. Needs segmented audio.

core_mechanic: Tap two grouped drumrolls that join into one continuous count to perform addition as a temporal sequence.

keep.name: Add with Drumrolls
keep.why_best: Counting-on / joining heard as one drumroll flowing into the next (K.OA.A.2); a distinct temporal addition mechanic.

core_mechanic: Tap pictures to hear them and pick the one that begins with a given spoken onset (auditory onset detection).

keep.name: Where's the Sound?
keep.why_best: Listen-first onset detection with no letters shown (RF.K.2.c); distinct from environmental-sound ID and from letter-anchored beginning-sound.

core_mechanic: Decode a low-to-high pitch sequence as a size cue and order objects to match the heard order.

keep.name: Hum the Pattern Up & Down
keep.why_best: Maps pitch onto a math attribute (size) and asks the child to order by decoding sound; the only cross-modal pitch-to-size design.

core_mechanic: Tap one pad per word left-to-right so each tap speaks that word, tracking one-to-one speech-to-print.

keep.name: Read it to the Beat
keep.why_best: One-tap-per-word in order instantiates print tracking (RF.K.1.c); the only concept-of-print word-correspondence design.

core_mechanic: Tap deep beats for tens and light beats for ones to sonify a two-digit number's place-value decomposition.

keep.name: Tap the Tens & Ones Beat
keep.why_best: Place value as a two-layer rhythm (heavy=tens, light=ones); a heard decomposition distinct from the visual column build.

core_mechanic: Listen to two rhythmic beat-sequences and tap which has more beats (or 'same') by counting by ear.

keep.name: Equal Beats
keep.why_best: Auditory magnitude comparison (K.CC.C.6) by counting beats; distinct from every visual more/less comparison by the modality.

core_mechanic: Deal discrete items one-to-one onto plates until each recipient has an equal share (fair-share/partitive division).

keep.name: Share It Fair
keep.why_best: Partitive division by dealing to equal shares with a leftover surfaced; the canonical fair-share. The round-robin process variant absorbs.

absorbed.name: One for You, One for Me

core_mechanic: Reproduce a multi-item reference set across several recipients so every set matches exactly (item-type and count).

keep.name: Everyone Gets the Same
keep.why_best: Reproduce a multi-item reference set across recipients (one-to-one correspondence / equal sets); the unit of fairness is a whole bag, distinct from equal-totals.

core_mechanic: Read a character's stated need and deliver the one item that solves it (need->item rule application).

keep.name: What Each Guest Needs
keep.why_best: Read a specific stated need and deliver the solving item (reading-comprehension + rule application); distinct from feeding by appetite or category sort.

core_mechanic: Connect each character/item to its partner by a stated semantic relationship (not identity).

keep.name: The Matchmaker
keep.why_best: Pairing gated by a semantic relationship (owner->pet, part->whole); a vocabulary-relationship skill distinct from identity match-pairs.

core_mechanic: Move items between two/several unequal holdings until they are equal (equalize a difference / even out).

keep.name: Make It Even
keep.why_best: Redistribute existing unequal holdings to equal (equalize a difference, halved); distinct from dealing from a source. Absorbs the equal-towers variant.

core_mechanic: Count out a named unit fraction of a set ('one-third of 12') into each recipient's cup.

keep.name: Give Each a Fraction of the Set
keep.why_best: Fractions OF A SET tied to division (3.NF.A.1/3.OA.A.2); bridges fraction language and equal sharing, distinct from partition-a-whole.

core_mechanic: Read a descriptive clue, infer the implied category, and choose the one item that fits it.

keep.name: The Right Gift
keep.why_best: Infer a category from a descriptive clue ('things that float') and pick the fitting item; comprehension + attribute-classification, distinct from a fixed need->item map.

core_mechanic: Arrange a turn-order so each actor gets exactly one turn before repeats, following an ordinal/sequence rule.

keep.name: Take Turns Fairly
keep.why_best: Build a fair sequence/rotation (ordinal reasoning, one-turn-each); distinct from seating adjacency and from single-actor path movement.

core_mechanic: Read a short social scene and tap the face/word naming how a character feels and why.

keep.name: How Are They Feeling?
keep.why_best: Comprehension-of-feelings (RL describe characters' feelings); interprets a narrated situation to an emotional state, distinct from need/clue->item maps.

core_mechanic: Tap two characters to trade so both get their wish, resolving a network of have->want swaps until all are satisfied.

keep.name: Trade to Make Everyone Happy
keep.why_best: Directed have->want swap-resolution where the correct swap depends on reciprocal satisfaction; a distinct relational-matching puzzle.

core_mechanic: Place items in a grid satisfying both a row-rule and a column-rule (nested category-and-subcategory).

keep.name: Tidy the Toy Shelf (Sort, Then Sort Again)
keep.why_best: Two-attribute cross-classification (a cell correct only if both row+col rules hold); distinct from single-rule binning. The only cross-classify design.

core_mechanic: Drag and rotate shapes to fill a bounded region edge-to-edge with no gaps or overlaps.

keep.name: Pack the Suitcase
keep.why_best: Grid-pack tiling of a bounded space (compose shapes to fill a region); distinct from blueprint-array and from free-form tangram. Grid-snap keeps it feasible.

core_mechanic: Slide/rotate/flip free-form shapes to compose a target silhouette of a recognizable figure.

keep.name: Fit the Tangram Picture
keep.why_best: Compose free-form geometric shapes into a named figure with rotation/flip; distinct from axis-aligned grid-pack. Constrained snap-angles keep it shell-feasible.

core_mechanic: Arrange letters/words into a left-to-right queue in alphabetical order.

keep.name: The Alphabet Queue
keep.why_best: Ordering by a symbolic sequence the child must know (the alphabet); distinct from numeric/measured order and from sound-sequencing within a word.

core_mechanic: Fill a ten-frame in conventional order to show a target number, revealing its 5+ structure.

keep.name: Fill the Ten-Frame Just Right
keep.why_best: Bounded 5+5 composition where placement order reveals subitizing structure; distinct from a linear number line and from a continuous pour-fill.

core_mechanic: Order informational cards (seed->tree, morning->night) by real-world temporal/causal order on a timeline.

keep.name: Chronological: What Came First?
keep.why_best: Informational time-order/lifecycle sequencing (RI.3); distinct from narrative plot-order retell by ordering real-world chronology.

core_mechanic: Sort coins/place-value tokens into the matching labeled tube AND arrange the tubes in least-to-greatest value order.

keep.name: Sort the Coins Into the Right Tubes
keep.why_best: Couples category-binning with numeric value-ordering and place value; distinct from two-perceptual-attribute cross-sort and from plain ordering.

core_mechanic: Complete a chain of triggers in the right count or first/next/last order, then run the contraption.

keep.name: Rube-Goldberg Trigger Builder
keep.why_best: Multi-step cause-effect chain where ORDER/role matters (first/next/last sequencing); distinct from a homogeneous domino count (which folds into C099 program-and-run).

core_mechanic: Turn a dial/crank to move a substance/plant through ordered states/stages and set it to a named stage.

keep.name: Seed-to-Bloom Time Crank
keep.why_best: Reversible ordered-stage transform targeting first/next/last sequence language (RI.1.3); absorbs the melt-meter states variant.

core_mechanic: Press the cause button that produces a stated outcome on the scene (single cause->effect matching).

keep.name: Weather Machine Cause-Effect
keep.why_best: Pure cause->effect reasoning: pick the input that yields the stated outcome (RI.1.3); distinct from a single-substance state dial.

core_mechanic: Add a grammatical ending (+s) to a word so it matches a depicted quantity (inflectional morphology).

keep.name: Word Plus-S Machine
keep.why_best: Word transform by appending a grammatical ending matched to picture-count (L.K.1.c plurals); distinct from phoneme substitution and from compound-weld.

core_mechanic: Change one letter/phoneme in a word to morph it into a new real word (phonemic substitution chains).

keep.name: Letter-Swap Morph Lab
keep.why_best: Phonemic substitution (cat->cap->hat) with a picture confirm (RF.K.2.e); distinct from appending an ending and from building a word from scratch.

core_mechanic: Tap fold-lines in sequence to fold a 2D net up into a named 3D solid.

keep.name: Shape-Fold Transformer
keep.why_best: Geometric 2D->3D fold (which folds make the solid); the only net-fold design, teaching 2D/3D relationships. Pre-rendered fold sprite-sheets keep it feasible.

core_mechanic: Adjust ingredient amounts to match a ratio or scale a whole recipe by a factor (double/half), then bake.

keep.name: Recipe Double & Half
keep.why_best: Scale every line by the same factor (doubling/halving) — the more K-3-reachable of the proportional pair; the ratio-lab sibling absorbs (it is the 6.RP variant).
